shots.title: Normalize npm package bin paths to avoid publish auto-correction (#517)
shots.notes: Normalized the root package `bin` targets from `./dist/...` to `dist/...` and added a package metadata regression to keep the publish warning from returning.

shots.title: Rerun npm publish dry-run and release packaging checks (#517)
shots.notes: `npm.cmd publish --dry-run --access public` now reports `@slope-dev/slope@1.58.0` without auto-correction warnings; package dry-run and built CLI version checks passed.

conditions.description: `npm pkg fix --dry-run` normalized package metadata in the worktree despite the dry-run flag, so the resulting diff was inspected before commit.

training.description: Release dry-runs should be treated as signal, not noise, when npm says it auto-corrected package metadata.
training.outcome: The package now publishes cleanly in dry-run mode and has regression coverage for the normalized bin paths.

nutrition.description: `corepack pnpm vitest run tests/cli/package-metadata.test.ts tests/cli/version.test.ts` passed: 5 tests.
`npm.cmd publish --dry-run --access public` passed without npm bin auto-correction warnings.
`slope map --check` reported current and `slope roadmap validate` passed with only historical warnings.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: A small but worthwhile release-polish shot. The warning was easy to ignore, and that is exactly why it deserved a sprint.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: If npm says it corrected publish metadata, make the correction explicit in source and add a regression.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: `npm pkg fix --dry-run` still changed the worktree, so inspect after diagnostic npm commands.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: S144 can resume with package metadata clean enough for trusted publishing.

bunker_locations: npm publish dry-run warnings can indicate source metadata drift even when the command exits 0.
`npm pkg fix --dry-run` may still leave a worktree diff.
yardage_book_updates: `package.json` bin targets now use `dist/cli/index.js` and `dist/mcp/index.js` without leading `./`.
`tests/cli/package-metadata.test.ts` guards the npm bin metadata shape.
course_management_notes: Issue #517 should close when the PR containing S143.98 merges.
Return to S144 final release validation after S143.98 closeout.
